Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class ProcessModelOperatingAction

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.ProcessModelOperatingAction
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ProcessModelOperatingAction extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable definition of one simulator-bound operating action for a ProcessModel.

An action retains stable identity, an area-qualified automation address, unit, provenance, and either continuous bounds or an exact enumerated discrete domain. Candidate application uses ProcessModel.getVariableValue(String, String) and ProcessModel.setVariableValue(String, double, String) so the action remains attached to the existing process-automation architecture. This class does not run the model or infer that a candidate is feasible.

State capture and restoration are explicit. A captured state is bound to the complete action identity and cannot be restored through a different or subsequently changed definition.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim Development Team

    • withReadBackTolerance

      public ProcessModelOperatingAction withReadBackTolerance(double absoluteTolerance, double relativeTolerance, String toleranceProvenance)
      Returns an otherwise identical action with an explicitly evidenced automation read-back tolerance.

      A read-back is accepted when its absolute residual does not exceed the larger of the declared absolute tolerance and the declared relative tolerance times max(1, abs(expected)). The absolute tolerance uses getUnit(). This evidence only qualifies write/read-back consistency; it does not establish process feasibility or operating approval.

      Parameters:
      absoluteTolerance - absolute tolerance in the declared action unit
      relativeTolerance - scale-aware relative tolerance
      toleranceProvenance - evidence source for the selected tolerance
      Returns:
      immutable action with the selected read-back tolerance

    • inspectCapability

      public ProcessModelOperatingAction.CapabilityAssessment inspectCapability(ProcessModel model)
      Inspects whether the action target is readable in the supplied model.

      A readable finite baseline remains capturable even when it lies outside the candidate domain; this permits exact restoration of an existing brownfield state. The assessment reports that condition explicitly and never proves writability or process feasibility.

      Parameters:
      model - process model to inspect
      Returns:
      immutable capability assessment

    • apply

      public ProcessModelOperatingAction.ApplicationResult apply(ProcessModel model, double candidateValue)
      Applies a valid candidate without running the process model.

      Invalid candidates are rejected without writing. After a write, the value is read back. A write/read-back failure triggers a best-effort rollback to the captured pre-write value and is reported rather than hidden.

      Parameters:
      model - process model
      candidateValue - candidate action value
      Returns:
      immutable application result

    • applyOrThrow

      public ProcessModelOperatingAction.ApplicationResult applyOrThrow(ProcessModel model, double candidateValue)
      Applies a candidate or throws when it is rejected.

      This method is useful as an external-evaluator setter because ProcessModelSimulationEvaluator converts the exception into explicit failed-evaluation evidence.

      Parameters:
      model - process model
      candidateValue - candidate action value
      Returns:
      successful immutable application result
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the candidate cannot be applied and verified

    • restore

      Restores an identity-matched captured state without running the model.
      Parameters:
      model - process model
      state - state previously captured by this exact action definition
      Returns:

      Throws:

    • registerWith

      public ProcessModelOperatingAction.ActionParameterBinding registerWith(ProcessModelSimulationEvaluator evaluator)
      Registers this action as a parameter in an external process-model evaluator.

      Continuous actions expose their bounds. Discrete actions expose the minimum and maximum only as an optimizer vector envelope; intermediate values still fail closed in the registered setter and callers must enumerate ProcessModelOperatingAction.ActionParameterBinding.getAllowedValues(). The current readable model value is retained as the parameter initial value.

      Parameters:
      evaluator - evaluator to extend
      Returns:
      immutable binding metadata
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the evaluator is null
      IllegalStateException - if the action target is unavailable
